title: patch_file fails on long README table rows
description: patch_file consistently fails to apply replacement diffs on long table rows in .moeb/README.md even when content is verified identical via read_file_range and grep_files. Three consecutive attempts with different context configurations all failed. Root cause appears to be that very long table row lines (500+ characters) cause diffy's removed-line matching to malfunction despite CRLF and trailing-whitespace normalization. A write_file fallback is required to complete each README update.
proposed_resolution: Fix removed-line byte-level matching in patch_file.rs for long content lines. Add a regression test for patch_file with 500+ character table row content. Consider adding a line-length threshold above which write_file is used instead of diffy.
